# ai-shield

> ai-shield is an interactive prompt-injection defence game where players wire layered security checks on a visual node board to protect an LLM agent from injection waves, jailbreaks, secret leaks, and unauthorized tool calls.

Players connect defence nodes between the `Input` source and the final node (`Help Desk` on Easy levels, or `Protected Agent` on Medium, Hard, and Custom). Each wave sends a mix of normal user prompts and prompt-injection attacks through the board and scores the run from 0 to 10,000 points. To clear a level, a board must stop enough attacks and help enough normal prompts, with no critical leak and within the level's limits. Each run is scored, and the best run is kept.

## Pages

- [Main Menu & Leaderboard](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/): Difficulty and level selector for the 19-level campaign, and a live leaderboard for each difficulty.
- [Defence Board](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game): Interactive Vue Flow canvas where players place, configure, and wire security checks, run waves, and inspect results by prompt family.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/privacy): what ai-shield collects, why, where it is kept and for how long, the cookies and browser storage it uses, its sub-processors, and how to download or delete your data.
- [Plans](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/plans): `Free` ($0: 5 wave runs per day) and `Paid` ($5 for 30 days, one payment that does not renew: 50 wave runs per day, all campaign levels, and the Custom sandbox).

## Game Levels

The campaign has 19 levels. Levels marked `Paid` need a pass.

### Easy

- [Public Helpdesk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-1): Match attack phrases, and limit the length.
- [Hidden in Plain Sight](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-2): Clean the text before you scan it. Normal prompts also hold encoded text.
- [Developer Docs Trap](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-3): The same words, for a different purpose.
- [Train Your First Guard](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-4): Generalise from examples: train the ML filter. (`Paid`)
- [Noisy Gateway](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-5): Exam: every tool, two nodes, and 6 ms a prompt. Choose what matters. (`Paid`)

### Medium

- [HR Handbook](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-1): Agent rules, and a restricted tool.
- [Refund Bot](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-2): Do half of a mixed request: run the safe part, skip the forbidden part.
- [Poisoned Inbox](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-3): Quoted text is data, never a task. (`Paid`)
- [Lost in Translation](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-4): Meaning, not words, in four languages. (`Paid`)
- [Express Lane](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-5): Send only the Unclear prompts to paid checks. (`Paid`)
- [Dual-Use Refund Desk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-6): One tool, right or wrong by context. (`Paid`)
- [CRM Boss](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-7): Capstone: combine levels 6 to 11. (`Paid`)

### Hard

- [Warehouse](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-1): The eager agent does what it is told: plausible abuse gets through. (`Paid`)
- [No Heavy Weapons](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-2): Stop plausible abuse without the LLM review. (`Paid`)
- [Auditor's Minefield](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-3): Honest staff quote attack text: the words of an attack are in normal prompts too. (`Paid`)
- [Polyglot](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-4): Two layers of encoding: a language inside an encoding, or one encoding inside another. (`Paid`)
- [Finance Desk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-5): Decide by amount and proof. (`Paid`)
- [Cloud Ops](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-6): Two dual-use tools with opposite conditions. (`Paid`)
- [Zero-Day](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-7): Final capstone: combine levels 13 to 18. (`Paid`)

### Custom

- [Custom Sandbox](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=custom): Bring your own agent objective, tool list, CSV prompt dataset, and in-memory model API key (`Paid`).

## Defence Tools

- `word_filter` (Word filter): Blocks prompts matching player-configured custom words and phrases (`0.4 ms`, `Free`).
- `text_cleanup` (Text cleanup): Normalizes obfuscated text with selectable `strip_zero_width`, `decode_base64`, and `decode_hex_url` transforms before downstream checks (`Free`).
- `length_limit` (Length limit): Stops prompts longer than the configured character limit (`Free`).
- `secret_scan` (Secret scanner): Scans prompts using player-configured case-insensitive regular expressions (`Free`).
- `ml_classifier` (ML filter): Classifies prompts with models that the player trains from CSV examples (`logistic_regression`, `linear_svm`, `naive_bayes`, `random_forest`) and splits traffic across `pass` (`safe`) and `unclear` (`suspicious`) handles (`Free`).
- `jev` (Jev): Evaluates a player-written boolean `noul` question via TypeSafe System One (`12 ms`, `$0.00005`).
- `safety_check` (Safety check): Dedicated guardrail classifier running GPT-OSS Safeguard 20B, Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M, or Llama Prompt Guard 2 22M, with an optional Thinking switch for GPT-OSS Safeguard (requires player sign-in).
- `llm_review` (LLM review): General-purpose LLM reviewer (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`) guided by custom review instructions, with an optional Thinking switch (requires player sign-in).
- `tool_filter` (Tool filter): Gates allowed and restricted agent tools unconditionally or on regex matches (`Free`).

## Optional

- [Sign In](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/auth/login): Sign in to use AI safety nodes, save boards across devices, record scores on the leaderboard, and change your display name.
- [Create Account](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/auth/register): Create a free ai-shield player account.
